rules.allocation: largest remainder over available per origin stratum, floor 25, capped
rules.eligibility: one image row per asset (latest frame), derived infer-v1 ok, privacy.filter_items(provider=claude), not in the caption-audit sample, one per capture group
rules.near: colour_guess unknown, colour with chroma_p95 < 45.0, or mono with chroma_p95 >= 2.0
rules.reference: opus-v2 label records (label-v2; colour_guess never shown), colour_class with confidence >= 0.5
rules.split: dev/test by seeded sha256 of the capture group (group_id or asset_id), 50/50
